changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpricelistsetupitem AS SELECT plsi.id, plsi.price_list_setup_id, plsi.waseel_item_mapping_id, plsi.sbs_catalog_id, plsi.item_type, plsi.source_id, plsi.item_code, plsi.item_name, plsi.unit_price, plsi.discount_percentage, plsi.is_active, plsi.created_by, plsi.created_date, plsi.last_modified_by, plsi.last_modified_date, plsi.requires_pre_authorization, plsi.non_standard_code FROM public.price_list_setup_item plsi;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpricelistsetupitem TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpricelistsetupitem FROM report_user;
